name: Home Screen Manager
description: TEST BUILD — Designs, orders, and renders hybrid Jellyfin/Abyss home sections using manual media, collections, metadata tags, and libraries.
overview: TEST BUILD — Home Screen Manager creation, ordering, rendering, and Abyss customization for Jellyfin 10.11.11.

versions.changelog: Adds Abyss Original artwork behavior; makes explicit media-bar image types request their Jellyfin endpoints directly; carries saved art and timing through the applied Custom CSS path; preserves timing with reduced motion; and aligns custom-row years with titles while retaining centered circular text.
